'''2008 Delaware State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship held on Sunday 14 September 2008 at Days of Knights, 173 E Main Street, Newark, Delaware, with [[Tim Simon]] as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-22840-331255">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=331255#331255 Official Thread - Delaware States 9/14], Tim Simon (Aglets), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (26 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080906211015/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=334264&sid=ae648eead5dc6f824b73aae4897ea966 Internet Archive]</ref> [[Tom Hollingworth]] won with a 6–0 record; 14 players took part besides Simon, and no final confrontation was played.<ref name="pcf-22840-336020">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=336020#336020 Official Thread - Delaware States 9/14], Casey Anis (spideyguy0), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (14 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080915092356/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=335617 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Days of Knights, 173 E Main Street, Newark, Delaware<ref name="pcf-22840-331255" />
* '''Dates:''' 14 September 2008<ref name="pcf-22840-331255" /><ref name="pcf-22840-336020" />
* '''Time:''' registration outside the store before it opened at noon; play to begin as close to noon as possible<ref name="pcf-22840-331255" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, six games then a final confrontation; no clear sleeves; decklists not required<ref name="pcf-22840-331255" />
* '''Entry fee:''' expected to be $10<ref name="pcf-22840-331255" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Tim Simon]], who would play only if there was an odd number of players, under the three-judge system<ref name="pcf-22840-331255" />
* '''Region:''' Yavin IV<ref name="pcf-22840-335443">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=335443#335443 Official Thread - Delaware States 9/14], Tim Simon (Aglets), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (11 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080915092356/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=335617 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Winner:''' [[Tom Hollingworth]]<ref name="pcf-22840-336020" />

== Organization ==

On 22 August 2008 Simon asked whether players from Maryland, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, New York and elsewhere would come to Delaware for "one last qualifier before worlds" at a store in Newark: normal constructed, with a decent cash prize.<ref name="sf-22744-329859">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=329859#p329859 DE states inquiry - Sept 14th], Aglets (Tim Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (22 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194447/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22744.html Internet Archive]</ref> The next day he noted that the date had been changed to a Sunday, based on the days the store had available.<ref name="sf-22744-330374">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=330374#p330374 DE states inquiry - Sept 14th], Aglets (Tim Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (23 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194447/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22744.html Internet Archive]</ref> Simon announced the event on 26 August 2008. He wrote that it was the first sanctioned ''Star Wars'' CCG qualifier held in Delaware "in who knows how long (maybe in the entire history of the PC? i honestly don't know)", and that the Players Committee did not require decklists for state tournaments.<ref name="pcf-22840-331255" /> On 12 September he wrote that he had heard from about 15 people and expected 15 to 20.<ref name="pcf-22840-335649">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=335649#335649 Official Thread - Delaware States 9/14], Tim Simon (Aglets), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (12 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080915092356/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=335617 Internet Archive]</ref>

Casey Anis posted the top three and the 3–3 players on the evening of the event.<ref name="pcf-22840-336020" /> Simon confirmed the top three and wrote that the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]] bye passed down to fourth place and was earned by Trevin Tyson ("hope I spelled that right"); he called Days of Knights a new venue that "worked out real nicely".<ref name="pcf-22840-336023">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=336023#336023 Official Thread - Delaware States 9/14], Tim Simon (Aglets), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (14 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080915092356/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=335617 Internet Archive]</ref> The full standings were not posted in the topic as captured.
